article_content: Brendan Eich, Mozilla's new CEO, resigned abruptly following criticism over his 2008 contribution to an initiative opposing same-sex marriage. The incident raises questions about the impact of past actions on current careers and the role of social media in public scrutiny.
translated_content: Brendan Eich, novoam CEO-a Mozilla, neočekivano je podneo ostavka zbog kritika povezanih uz njegovu podršku inicijativi protiv istovrsnih brakova 2008. Ovaj incident postavlja pitanja o utjecu prošlosti na sadašnju karijeru i ulogu društvenih medija u javnoj istrazi.
